description: Extend WebBridge local transport projection: direct async adapter delivery, opt-in lifecycle notifications, stable transport identity propagated once through validated Delivery, sync bounded local reply wait/no duplicate live final/no accepted-work cancellation. Keep Channels delivery confirmation and public projections. Delete RequestOwner after tests migrated, no replacement GenServer/ETS/global registry. Public widget protocol consumed upstream only; Agent/Engine see opaque references. Regression-first tests sync queued ack, async no answer, correlated stream and persisted final, errors, timeout/disconnect and isolation. Action reuse local-only transport over existing CommunicationBridge and NodeRouter role actions; no new execution manager.
title: [zaq-pkd.20] Direct widget delivery and RequestOwner removal
